evidence.family_analysis: Palula ghróom/Biori ghráam, Astori giróom and Gilgit gáam have early accent on the inherited long root. Hultman2023Table6p12 explicitly gives Kalkoti draám with final High, making village a genuine residual of the simple Palula E→Kalkoti zero-High correspondence. It also lacks the Low one might predict from Palula ghr. Earlier unmarked Kalkoti draam citations supply only segmental evidence and must not erase Hultman's marked reading.
